messages:
Priya: Morning team — quick jumpstart check for shiproom later. TL;DR: embed-cache rollout in staging, spec updates landed, need 2 quick CRs and one regression test.

Alex: On embed-cache rollout — finished the config tweak last night. Saw 10% perf uplift in staging. Will push canary after QA signoff.

Casey: I ran the regression suite against staging around 06:30. Found flaky test in rerank-model integration (timeout on long-query). Repro steps in the ticket #PROD-412.

Priya: Thanks @Casey. @Alex can you add a fallback timeout in the client for that path? If not, we should delay canary.

Alex: Yeah I can add a 2500ms client timeout and a retry with jitter. Will open a tiny PR in ~30m.

Jordan: Heads-up — PMs want an ETA for the doc update so support has the new prompts. Priya, can you drop the updated spec link?

Priya: Pushed the spec to the repo: https://git.redwood/s/repo/specs/embed-cache.md — outline at the top: rollout plan + fallback behavior. Add comments inline if anything's missing.

Casey: I can run another pass after the PR. Also can do a focused smoke for long-query rerank once the client timeout is in.

Alex: PR: https://git.redwood/s/repo/pull/834 — small change, tests included. cc @Casey for the smoke.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary build started for service/embed-cache (canary-2024-07-03-05:10). Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/98324

Jordan: Nice — if the canary passes, let's wait 2 hours then roll to 20% traffic. Keep an eye on tail-latency dashboards.

Priya: Blockers: none besides the rerank timeout. Please flag anything urgent here.

Alex: Tagging @Casey — running smoke now. Will report within 15m.

Casey: Smoke done. Rerank long-query still flaky, but with the client timeout+retry it's stable in 9/10 runs. Marking as acceptable for canary. :thumbsup:

Priya: Great — plan: monitor canary for 1h, then 20% for 2h, then full rollout if no regressions. I'll update the shiproom doc and ping CS.

Jordan: I'll watch the SLO dashboard and post any anomalies. Everyone else — shout here if you need help.

Priya: Thanks team — short and focused. See y'all in shiproom.
